patches.name: Eternal YouTube History
patches.description: Writes Android YouTube watch/progress directly to your private Eternal D1 ledger and can style watched thumbnails or hide watched feed cards from the local cache.

release_notes:
Canonical unpacked Chrome extension release. The optional Windows updater remains available for users who want automatic source replacement, but is not required.

SHA-256: 5edf48c64734b42b794ef9ca4c3688a57aebb6fc72156caaabb54f2e2a64a247
Size: 117648 bytes

Existing unpacked install: close Chrome, overwrite the current extension directory with the ZIP's extension/ contents, then reopen Chrome. Do not remove/re-add the extension; this preserves its ID and storage. If desired, windows-updater/Install-EternalPcAutoUpdater.ps1 can separately register the non-resident updater.
